dialect.detail: IBM CICS/VSAM online program; EXEC CICS translated by preprocessor (kxdfhei1 calls with DFHEIV0 hex literals); DFHEIBLK/DFHCOMMAREA linkage section pattern typical of IBM CICS translator output

purpose.domain_detail: Central States Health and Life – coversheet/form definition billing system; adds new form records to a VSAM KSDS file (FORMDEFS)
purpose.summary: CSADDBL is a CICS business-logic subprogram that accepts input via a commarea (form name, month, description, messages, comments), validates and converts the month abbreviation to a numeric code, writes a new form-definition record to the VSAM KSDS file FORMDEFS, and returns pass/fail status with an output commarea.

notable_features: EXEC CICS WRITE to VSAM KSDS (FORMDEFS)
CICS translator output: kxdfhei1 calls with hex-encoded DFHEIV0 literals
Month-name table with REDEFINES and OCCURS
Inline copybook expansions (FORMREC, CSADD-COMMAREA) with change log

verdict.notes: Source was truncated at 16000 chars but the visible portion is complete enough for classification. The EXEC CICS statements appear in commented-out form alongside their pre-translated kxdfhei1 equivalents, which is the standard IBM CICS command-level translator pattern. The file was authored by 'Pablo' at Colleyville, Texas for Central States Health and Life (insurance domain).
